title: Fix the provider guide tool-listing command and field names
prompt:
Change only src/app/docs/guides/provider-quickstart/page.tsx among production files. Evidence: src/app/docs/guides/provider-quickstart/page.tsx:78-106 targets the nonexistent /api/v1/bazaar/tools route and sends name, pricePerCall, and inputSchema. The existing handler is src/app/api/bazaar/tools/route.ts; lines 56-60 require tool_name, and lines 78-79 consume price_cents_override and input_schema. Parsing the rendered Step 2 snippet confirmed neither tool has tool_name. Even after correcting the URL, the example cannot register either tool.

Correct only Step 2 and its adjacent field-name explanation: use /api/bazaar/tools, tool_name, input_schema, and price_cents_override. Express the advertised $0.01 and $0.05 examples as 1 and 5 cents, and describe zero as free. Preserve the example tool names and input schemas. Keep the header placeholder unchanged and do not expand this job into other steps, registration, verification, or payment behavior.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/provider-quickstart-tool-payload.test.ts. Render the actual page with in-memory TypeScript transpilation, extract the Step 2 curl body, and parse it as JSON. Assert the URL resolves to the existing route, required snake_case keys and nested schemas survive, obsolete keys are absent, and cents match the displayed dollar examples. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/provider-quickstart-tool-payload.test.ts. Do not execute curl or contact services. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
